recommended_duration: 24-72 hours before any P5C (old-DB retirement) review begins

watch_items.how: supervisorctl status for watchtower_listener/creator_funding_worker/watchtower_api, all RUNNING with stable uptime, no crash-restart loops
SELECT COUNT(*)/MAX(id) FROM transfer_index on database/flex_complete_database.db should advance smoothly with normal traffic patterns, no stalls
spot-check historical queries via TransferReaderFactory continue to find COLD-only data correctly
if/when activated, warm-path latency should remain in the ~10-17s accepted range, not degrade
grep logs/supervisor/*.log for 'database is locked', 'busy', sustained connection errors -- single transient retries are normal, storms are not
periodic curl to :5002, watch for 5xx responses or timeouts
periodic digest re-check against the frozen baselines (8ec94921.../ecbd1426...) -- any change would be a serious, separate concern unrelated to this migration
count should remain 8 unless a genuine new discovery occurs through normal operation
monitor for unexpected growth beyond normal transfer_index accumulation; both the new HOT DB and the quarantined old DB (15.4GB) currently coexist on disk

confirm its allowlist (abandoned intelligence_snapshots/*.tmp.* only) does not expand scope or mistakenly target the new HOT DB, COLD segments, summary store, checkpoint cache, or the quarantined old DB

thresholds_for_concern.immediate_rollback_trigger_if_seen: missing transfer evidence, identity mismatch discovered post-hoc, Watchtower/3SW2 digest change, writer cannot persist to new HOT DB, old quarantined DB shows any write activity, sustained DB lock failures, critical API regression, COLD segment/summary corruption
thresholds_for_concern.investigate_but_not_necessarily_rollback: isolated transient lock retries, minor latency variance in aggregate queries, disk usage growth consistent with normal traffic volume

next_milestone_not_yet_authorized: STORAGE-LIFECYCLE-P5C -- old DB retirement/deletion review, requires separate explicit human authorization after the observation window concludes without incident.
